headline.zh: 苏州河畔百年粮仓咖啡馆
headline.en: Century-old granary by the Suzhou River

traits.zh: 位于苏州河畔百年历史建筑，曾是杜月笙私家粮仓
traits.en: Housed in a century-old historic building, formerly Du Yuesheng's private grain warehouse

traits.zh: 保留典型近代英式仓储建筑风格
traits.en: Preserves typical early 20th-century English warehouse architecture

traits.zh: 招牌：河畔意式浓缩，夜宵转为皮特-纳特起泡酒
traits.en: Signature: Creek-side espresso turns into pét-nat nightcap

traits.zh: 营业至凌晨2点，夜间有皮特-纳特酒供饮
traits.en: Open until 2am, with pét-nat available after dark

traits.zh: 临河敞开大门，可吹风品咖啡
traits.en: Open-facing riverside entrance for breezy coffee sipping

focus.zh: 夜宵时段为主，专注度中等

adventure.zh: 意式浓缩后转为皮特-纳特，饮品不寻常
